name: Seviyan Ji Khirni (Sindhi Vermicelli Pudding)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 tbsp South Asian vermicelli (short, fine wheat noodles)

steps: Heat ghee in a skillet. Add vermicelli, and fry over low heat until golden brown. Remove from the heat.
Bring the milk to a boil. Add vermicelli, cardamom, and saffron. Simmer until the vermicelli are tender and the milk is reduced to a little more than half the original volume.
Mix in the sugar, and boil for 5–7 minutes.
